payment

How to buy a pattern

Patterns are sold through Tribute — a simple and secure platform. Here's how it works:

1

Select the pattern price

When the Tribute page opens, you'll see a default amount. Find the price that matches the pattern (shown on the product card — e.g. $6) and tap it. If it's not in the list, tap Other Amount and type the price. Then select Bank Card and tap Add Bank Card.

2

Log in with your email

Tap Email → Get Code and enter your email address. A 4-digit code will arrive in your inbox — enter it to confirm. This is the address your pattern will be sent to.

3

Select your card's country

Search for the country that issued your card. You'll then be asked to confirm your card type (American or EU). Tap Go to Payment.

4

Enter your card details

Fill in your card number, expiry date, CVV, and cardholder name — then tap Pay. The pattern will land in your inbox right away!

Here's what you'll see — step by step

Step 1 · Select the pattern price

Step 1 · Choose Bank Card → Add Bank Card

Step 2 · Log in with your email

Step 3 · Search your card's country

Step 3 · Select your card type

Step 4 · Enter card details & pay

Your card details are processed directly by Tribute's secure payment system - LarkinsStudio never sees or stores any of your payment information.

about

Hello, I'm LarkinsStudio

I'm the person behind LarkinsStudio - I design cross-stitch patterns that feel like a warm hug. Cozy scenes, little animals, botanical details - things that make you want to pick up a needle right away.

Each pattern is designed to be a pleasure to stitch: clear grid, full DMC colour list, and notes on fabric and sizing — so you can focus on the fun part.

  • Original designs you won't find anywhere else
  • Instant PDF download after purchase
  • Full DMC thread palette in every pattern
  • Something for every skill level
